summary: Proposal/Contract System Testing Complete - All 24 backend tests passed, all frontend features working. Feature Flags (6 toggles), Proposal CRUD, OrderItems with item_type (Food/Service/Rental/Fee), Margin Tracking with internal_cost, Financials tab with breakdown by item type, Audit Logging for changes after acceptance, Document generation buttons.

Proposal: GET /api/proposals/event/{id} auto-creates proposal with proposal_number
Proposal: Proposal includes margin fields (total_cost, total_margin, margin_percentage)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Proposal/Contract System complete. New features: 1) Feature Flags in Settings > Features tab with 6 toggles (proposal editing, order items, margin tracking, document autogeneration, custom fields, food ops), 2) ProposalEditor component replaces EventOrderEditor on Event Details page, 3) OrderItems with item_type (Food, Service, Rental, Fee) and internal_cost for margin tracking, 4) Financials tab shows revenue/cost/margin breakdown by item type, 5) Audit logging tracks changes after proposal is Accepted, 6) Documents tab for generating Proposal, Contract, Invoice, Kitchen Sheet, Mise en Place, Packing List.
